text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin hasn't arrived for our<n>training session.
Just as I'm starting<n>to think she might not show up
at all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, my bike tire burst, and it took a<n>while to get it
fixed...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The front one punctures so easily.<n>Hmm. Maybe I
put too much weight<n>on it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But forget all that—I'm really sorry<n>about this!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although her tardiness wasn't her<n>fault, I warn
Ines Fujin to be more<n>careful.
